name: Gangsta 2-6
description: Gangsta 2-6 is a Chicago-based street gang and branch of the Gangster Two Six nation. The broader Two Six gang originated in the Little Village neighborhood along 26th Street around 1964. The 'Gangster' designation was coined by Alfonso Ayala Junior at 38th and Albany in the late 1970s, initially applying only to that Albany set; by late 1986, all Two Six factions had dropped the 'Insane' prefix and 'Gangster Two Six' became the universal name. Aligned with the Folk Nation, the gang expanded into Chicago's western suburbs — including Cicero, Berwyn, and Countryside — during the 1980s and early 1990s. The gang is known for a long-standing rivalry with the Latin Kings.
